product_summary: Two overlapping catalogues for the same Delhi entity. (1) advanceinorganics.in (footer: 'ADVANCEIN ORGANICS LLP', B-268 North Ex Mall, Rohini Sector-9, Delhi-110085) lists: Tri Calcium Phosphate, Glucono Delta Lactone, Xylitol, Erythritol, Citrulline, Sodium Benzoate, Calcium Propionate, Mono Ammonium Phosphate, Mono Potassium Phosphate, Tetra Sodium Pyrophosphate, Creatine Monohydrate, Mono Sodium Phosphate; positioned as food ingredients for bakery/bread/cookie/beer/sausage applications; self-described 'manufacturer, importer, trader and exporters'. (2) IndiaMART storefront 'Advance Inorganics' (B-215 IFC Holambi Kalan, Narela Phase-1, Delhi-110040; GST 07AAGPK3622A1ZB; IEC 0502065940; contact Abhishek Gupta) lists: phosphate chemicals (zinc phosphate, TCP FCC food grade, monocalcium phosphate), lactate/propionate/caseinate (DMG emulsifier, GDL, lactic acid food grade), artificial sweeteners (Neomalt 200X, crystalline fructose 25kg, erythritol), acetates & oxalates (potassium carbonate granular, sodium oxalate, potassium acetate anhydrous), agro chemicals (ferric EDTA 12%, copper glycinate, ferrous glycinate), laboratory chemicals (magnesium phosphate tribasic, zinc acetate), vitamins & amino acids, food additives. Note the IndiaMART page states 'Legal Status of Firm: Proprietorship' while the website footer says LLP - entity-form inconsistency worth flagging, and the two addresses/GST differ from the LLP address, so the IndiaMART listing may be a sister/legacy proprietorship concern.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader (self-described manufacturer + importer + trader + exporter; broad multi-category catalogue with third-party brands such as 'Neomalt 200X' and resold vitamins/amino acids is a strong trader signal)
comment: Declared 170250 (chemically pure fructose) is corroborated only indirectly: the IndiaMART catalogue offers 'Fructose Crystalline 25kg' as an artificial-sweetener line item, so the code is plausible but the product is a minor catalogue item, not a core line - status: заявлено, не подтверждено (no customs line available to this researcher). Declared 282739 (other chlorides) is NOT corroborated by either catalogue: no chloride product (CaCl2, ZnCl2, KCl, NH4Cl) appears on the website or the IndiaMART range, so this code looks wrong/legacy - status: wrong (not found in product range). The bulk of the real range is food additives and inorganic/organic fine chemicals: phosphates (2835), gluconates/lactates (2918), propionates/acetates (2915), polyols xylitol/erythritol (2905), amino acids and creatine (2922/2925), benzoate (2916), chelates (3824). Industry classification 'Продукты питания и FMCG' is only partly right: the company is a food-ingredient/fine-chemical supplier, not an FMCG brand owner - the correct framing is 'химия / пищевые ингредиенты (food additives & industrial chemicals)'. Product lines entirely missing from the declaration: phosphates (largest line), glucono delta lactone, xylitol/erythritol, calcium propionate, sodium benzoate, acetates/oxalates, chelated agro micronutrients, vitamins and amino acids. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company is retained, declared codes corrected to the actual range above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. All product data comes from the company's own website and IndiaMART storefront only - no shipment or customs record was consulted or found, so every line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
